summary: AUT-011: forward installed local Ollama tags under an adaptive policy instead of failing as unknown model

delivery.outcome: With an adaptive (cloud class) policy active, an exact local Ollama tag that is installed upstream and not declared by the policy is forwarded natively to Ollama (keeping format/keep_alive/num_ctx) instead of failing as 'unknown model'. Declared tags still take the adaptive path, missing tags still fail, and behaviour without an adaptive policy is unchanged. Unblocks autonom's local binder/generator on hosts that run the proxy with an adaptive policy (AUT-011).
nonGoals: No change to adaptive class routing for declared models.
No cloud fallback for local tags.

architecture.decision: One handler helper _may_forward_locally replaces the two 'not adaptive.policy() and _is_unmanaged_local_ollama_model' checks from ticket-239; installation is read from the cached upstream tag list.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_proxy_adaptive_forward.py tests/test_proxy.py tests/test_proxy_models.py tests/test_adaptive.py
autonom run --simulate --for 24h through a proxy built from this branch with the production adaptive policy
validation.evidence: goal cycles complete (bind succeeds), previously 0 cycles with 'unknown model'
